tools.name: everhour_get_current_user
tools.description: Get the Everhour user that owns the API key: id, name, email, role, timezone and permissions. Good first call to learn the user id. Everhour API: GET /users/me.

tools.name: everhour_list_users
tools.description: List team members with their role, status and groups. Search by name with query. Cost fields show 0 unless the key's user has the costs permission. Everhour API: GET /team/users.

tools.name: everhour_list_clients
tools.description: List clients, optionally filtered by name. Everhour API: GET /clients.

tools.name: everhour_list_projects
tools.description: List projects, optionally filtered by name, with their users and billing or budget fields. Everhour API: GET /projects.

tools.name: everhour_get_project
tools.description: Get one project by id, with its users, billing and budget. Everhour API: GET /projects/{project_id}.

tools.name: everhour_list_project_tasks
tools.description: List the tasks of one project. Set exclude_closed to hide closed tasks, or query to search by name. Everhour API: GET /projects/{project_id}/tasks.

tools.name: everhour_search_tasks
tools.description: Search tasks across projects by name. Narrow to one project with project (an encoded project id). Use the returned task id for time tracking. Everhour API: GET /tasks/search.

tools.name: everhour_get_task
tools.description: Get one task by id, with its project, status, assignees and tracked time. Everhour API: GET /tasks/{task_id}.

tools.name: everhour_list_time_records
tools.description: List time records across the team for an inclusive date range (from and to, YYYY-MM-DD). Returns the task and user of each record. Everhour API: GET /team/time.

tools.name: everhour_list_user_time_records
tools.description: List one user's time records for an inclusive date range (from and to, YYYY-MM-DD). Everhour API: GET /users/{user_id}/time.

tools.name: everhour_list_task_time_records
tools.description: List the time records of one task for an inclusive date range (from and to, YYYY-MM-DD). Everhour API: GET /tasks/{task_id}/time.

tools.name: everhour_get_running_timer
tools.description: Get the timer that runs for the key's user now: status, task, start time and elapsed duration. Everhour API: GET /timers/current.

tools.name: everhour_start_timer
tools.description: Start a timer on a task for the key's user. A timer that already runs is stopped first and saved as a time record. Everhour API: POST /timers.

tools.name: everhour_stop_timer
tools.description: Stop the key's user's running timer. Its elapsed time is saved as a time record on the task, and the saved record is returned. Everhour API: DELETE /timers/current.

tools.name: everhour_add_time
tools.description: Log time on a task for one day. At most one record exists per user, date and task: posting again sets the duration to the new value, it does not add to it. Everhour API: POST /time.

tools.name: everhour_update_time_record
tools.description: Change one time record by id: duration, date, task, user or comment. The body replaces the record's fields that you send. Everhour API: PUT /time/{time_id}.

tools.name: everhour_delete_time_record
tools.description: Delete one time record by id. Everhour keeps the history trail, but the record leaves all time listings. Everhour API: DELETE /time/{time_id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: everhour_get_current_user · Private data: everhour_get_current_user, everhour_list_time_records, everhour_list_user_time_records, everhour_list_task_time_records, everhour_start_timer, everhour_stop_timer, everhour_add_time, everhour_update_time_record, everhour_delete_time_record · Public sink: everhour_get_current_user, everhour_start_timer, everhour_add_time, everhour_update_time_record · Destructive: everhour_stop_timer, everhour_delete_time_record.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: everhour_get_current_user · Private data: everhour_get_current_user, everhour_list_time_records, everhour_list_user_time_records, everhour_list_task_time_records, everhour_start_timer, everhour_stop_timer, everhour_add_time, everhour_update_time_record, everhour_delete_time_record · Public sink: everhour_get_current_user, everhour_start_timer, everhour_add_time, everhour_update_time_record · Destructive: everhour_stop_timer, everhour_delete_time_record

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
